answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the prism until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the saffron of the next round. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, weighted by independent path length, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. By the pigment of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
